rows: Let me say the true thing first. I do not want this to be easy. I want it to mean something.
I can brawl when the moment asks for it. The moment usually asks for feeling first.
A risk is only worth it if somebody in the building cares what happens next.
Slow is fine. It gives people time to feel what is coming.
The people have trusted me with their evenings. I want to earn that trust properly.
In brief: I care about this match, and I am not ashamed to say so.
I am carrying a title story, and I want to tell it honestly.
Note the stance. I am not hiding how much this matters.
You mention technique. Fine. Show me the part of it that means something to you.
Strikes are loud. The thing underneath them is what I want to hear.
A risk without a reason is only noise. Give me a reason.
A stall keeps the feeling out. I do not want that.
The people deserve to feel something real. Give them that and I will give you everything I have.
You say I am not really invested. Watch me be invested for the next twelve minutes.
You are proud of your {strength}. Sensible. I can hear what it means to you, and I respect it.
I have thought about your {strength} for longer than I should have, and I want to meet it honestly.
You did not flinch. I admire that. I am the other way round tonight.
Point taken. I can see we both care about the same thing.
I could say something cutting about that. It would not help, and it would not be true.
Pinfall, one time. Keep me down and I will tell you exactly how it felt.
On the mat I will stay close to you, and you will feel every bit of it.
Grounded or standing, I am still here, and I still mean it.
Stay in front of me, and let us see what this is worth.
Better answer. It sounded like you meant it, and I can tell the difference.
You have not answered yet. I am not going anywhere until you do.
Point taken. That matters to me too.
I will allow that. We will find out what it means at the bell.
I will give this match my whole heart, and I will not hold anything back.
My approach is honest. You will see it on the night.
Whatever happens, I want you to know this was real for me.
The job is still open. What matters to me is still in front of me.
I have one more true thing to say, and you will hear it when the bell goes.
